source_note: 对含参数方程根的估计
english_source_note: Estimates for Roots of Parameterized Equations
callout_id: 对含参数方程根的估计#10
statement_en:
Assume \(\\phi(x)\) is analytic in a neighborhood of \(x=r\), and \(\\phi(r)\
eq 0\). Consider the equation
\\[
x=r+s\\phi(x).
\\]
Then in a neighborhood of \(s=0\), the equation has a unique analytic solution
\\[
x(s)=r+\\sum_{i\\ge 1} c_i s^i,
\\]
where the coefficients are given by
\\[
c_i=\\frac{1}{i!}\\lim_{x\	o r}\\frac{d^{\,i-1}}{dx^{\,i-1}}\\big[(x-r)^i\\phi(x)^i\\big].
\\]
callout_body: $\phi(x)$在$x=r$的邻域中解析，且$\phi(r)\neq 0$。考虑方程$$x=r+s\phi(x)$$则在$s=0$的邻域中，方程存在唯一解析解$$x(s)=r+\sum_{i\geq 1}a_i s^i $$其中系数$$c_i = \frac{1}{i!}\lim_{x\to r } \frac{d^{i-1}}{d x^{i-1}}[(x-r)^i\phi(x)^i]$$
